_doc: Which INFORMATION each declared study used. Added by the 2026-10-14 audit; the registry itself is not edited. Families are defined by the data a signal is computed from, not by its name: two rules computed from one price series are one source of information however different they look.

price_ta.label: price and volume patterns (technical analysis, ML on price features)

xs_factors.label: cross-sectional factors and fundamentals (momentum, reversal, value, quality, combinations)

earnings_info.label: earnings announcements and information diffusion
earnings_info.closed: 2026-10-28: real before costs, decayed below retail costs (trials 10, 12, 14, 34, 59). No further trials in this family without new data or a new mechanism.

flows_altdata.label: institutional flows and alternative data (short interest, insider filings, index rebalancing, government contracts)

microstructure.label: market microstructure and costs (overnight premium, measured spreads)

crypto_carry.label: crypto perpetual funding carry and crowding

structural.label: structural and corporate-action arbitrage (issuer tender offers, odd-lot priority)
